I'm Jaeda, an EIT (Engineer-in-Training) who graduated from civil engineering at UBC Okanagan this past June. During my degree, I worked in the Construction Integration and Digitalization Lab under Dr. Qian Chen.

In my fourth year, I proposed and led a capstone project called BIM-AI Smart Construction, which won first place in Software and Data Systems, an experience that sparked my interest in data science. 

I'm now pursuing a Master of Data Science at UBC, and I'm excited to explore where the intersection of civil engineering and data science can take me, whether that's in intelligent infrastructure, AI-driven systems, or something I haven't discovered yet.
